Civil.grounding: Small group (n=6) with varied site-focused resumes: Concrete 3, Estimation 1, Surveying 1, Structural Analysis 1, Reinforced Concrete 1; STAAD/ETABS 0. JD is a standard site/structural posting, NOT fitted to the resumes -- several resumes are expected to score low, which is legitimate negative signal. Per-JD metrics for Civil are descriptive only.
responsibilities: Supervise site execution and coordinate contractors and drawings.
Prepare quantity estimates, measurements and bills.
Carry out surveying and setting-out work.
Check structural details, reinforcement and concrete works.
Civil.summary: Civil Engineer to execute and supervise building construction works, from structural design support to site measurement and billing.
Civil.title: Civil Engineer (Site / Structural)

Electrical.grounding: Requirements ranked by frequency in the 19 assigned resumes: Automation 8, Control Systems 7, PLC 6, MATLAB 6, Instrumentation 5, Power Distribution 3, Power Systems 3, SCADA 2, Electrical Design 2, Embedded Systems 2.
responsibilities: Design and commission PLC-based control and automation systems.
Work on power distribution, instrumentation and electrical design.
Use simulation tools for system modelling and validation.
Support installation, testing and maintenance of electrical systems.
Electrical.summary: Electrical Engineer to design, commission and maintain control, automation and power systems.
Electrical.title: Electrical Engineer

Mechanical.grounding: Requirements ranked by frequency in the 45 assigned resumes: AutoCAD 21, Process Improvement 13, Lean Manufacturing 12, SolidWorks 12, Six Sigma 11, CNC 10, Welding 10, ANSYS 10, Manufacturing Processes 7, GD&T 6.
responsibilities: Prepare 2D/3D designs and engineering drawings for components and assemblies.
Validate designs with simulation and analysis tools.
Support CNC manufacturing and shop-floor production.
Drive process improvement, quality and cost reduction on the production line.
Mechanical.summary: Mechanical Engineer to design, analyse and improve mechanical components, systems and manufacturing processes.
Mechanical.title: Mechanical Engineer

Software.grounding: Requirements ranked by frequency in the 16 assigned resumes: JavaScript 7, Python 5, SQL 5, REST API 5, Java 4, HTML 3, CSS 3, Git 2, AWS 1, Docker 0. HTML/CSS are stored as displayed and canonicalised to the graph nodes HTML5/CSS3 by the matcher alias list. Uses the ORIGINAL v3 tech graph only -- no new software nodes were added.
responsibilities: Develop features across the stack and write tested, reviewed code.
Design and consume REST APIs and work with relational databases.
Use version control and cloud deployment in daily work.
Software.summary: Software Developer to build and maintain web applications and backend services in an agile team.
Software.title: Software Developer

Technician.grounding: Requirements ranked by frequency in the 32 assigned resumes: Troubleshooting 22, Repair 19, Installation 17, Schematics 11, Preventive Maintenance 7, Diagnostic 6, Calibration 6, Equipment Maintenance 5, Hand Tools 5, Safety Compliance 1. Safety Compliance is included despite low frequency because it is a standard requirement of technician postings.
responsibilities: Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on equipment.
Diagnose faults, read schematics and complete repairs.
Install and commission equipment and document the work.
Follow safety procedures and maintain accurate service records.
Technician.summary: Engineering Technician to install, maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment in the field and on site.
Technician.title: Engineering Technician (Maintenance / Field Service)
